_comment: Canonical fast-moving facts package-manager-ops encodes, and the tables scripts/pm-audit.py reads at run time (Node + PHP end-of-life dates, LTS codenames, native CLI names). scripts/check-pm-facts.py --offline asserts the skill prose names every token here; --live re-checks the tables against nodejs/Release schedule.json, php.net, the npm registry, getcomposer.org and GitHub. Edit deliberately: a change here changes what pm-audit reports. Verified 2026-10-05.

node._comment: From https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/Release/main/schedule.json. 'end' = end of life. Odd majors never reach LTS. From 27 on, one major per year and every line becomes LTS (nodejs.org blog, 2026-03-10). 26's codename is not assigned in schedule.json yet, so it is absent here on purpose: --live flags drift once it is.

php._comment: From https://www.php.net/supported-versions.php and https://www.php.net/eol.php. security_end = the day support ends; pm-audit treats a version as end-of-life the day after.

packages._comment: documented_major = the major the prose commits to. --live: DRIFT when the registry's latest major is ahead, or the package is gone.

npm.role: Node's bundled manager; Node 24/26 still bundle npm 11

corepack.role: standalone since Node 25 stopped bundling it

nvm-windows/nvm.role: Windows Node version manager (v2 rewrite, new repo)

text_watch._comment: Status statements the skill relies on. --live: DRIFT when the page no longer contains the phrase (the status changed - re-read and update the prose).

pnpm_npmrc_placeholders_ignored.contains: placeholder in any of these positions is ignored

dated_facts._comment: Point-in-time facts the prose must state verbatim; --offline fails if a token disappears from SKILL.md/references. The pnpm_npmrc_* and packagist_* entries were verified 2026-10-06 against the pnpm v11.5.3 and v10.34.2 releases, pnpm.io/npmrc and Packagist's shutdown notice; pm-audit's registry.pnpm.placeholder-ignored message names the same versions, so change both together.

composer._comment: From https://getcomposer.org/versions: the '1' channel is marked eol with maintenance-until. pm-audit's php.composer.v1 message quotes it; --live re-reads it.
composer.lines_comment: lines = every Composer 2.x minor line. 2.2 (the LTS, maintenance-until 2026-12-31) and 2.10 (current stable) come from https://getcomposer.org/versions, which lists no other minors; 2.0-2.9 end dates are the day the next minor shipped, from https://endoflife.date/api/v1/products/composer/. end null = still current. --live re-checks the two getcomposer lines. Verified 2026-10-07.
composer.feature_floors_comment: First Composer minor that ships each safety feature, from https://github.com/composer/composer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md: 2.9.0 added automatic blocking of package versions with security advisories (audit.block-insecure, default true; --no-security-blocking arrived in 2.9.2); 2.10.0 enabled blocking of known-malware packages at install time by default.

craft._comment: Craft CMS support policy: each major gets active support, then one more year of critical security fixes (security_end). Source: https://craftcms.com/knowledge-base/supported-versions (Craft CMS 3: 30 Apr 2024, 4: 30 Apr 2026, 5: 31 Dec 2031), cross-checked against https://endoflife.date/api/v1/products/craft-cms/. Verified 2026-10-07.

legacy_packages_comment: Packages pm-audit flags as end-of-life or abandoned (legacy.* findings). id keeps the original finding id for bower and node-sass, else legacy.package. versions = an npm range the entry applies to, or '*'. Each reason was checked 2026-10-07: bower - bower.io says 'While Bower is maintained, we recommend using Yarn and Vite' and the last release is 1.8.14; node-sass - npm deprecation notice 'no longer supported', repo archived; laravel-mix - last release 6.0.49 on 2022-06-09, last commit 2024-01-24; vue <3 - v2.vuejs.org/eol 'End of Life on December 31st, 2023'; vue-template-compiler - compiles Vue 2 templates only, npm latest is 2.7.16; webpack <5 - 'webpack-4' dist-tag stops at 4.47.0 while latest is 5.x; request - npm deprecation notice 'request has been deprecated'; phantomjs-prebuilt - npm deprecation notice 'this package is now deprecated' and upstream README 'development is suspended'. Edit deliberately: this list is read by pm-audit.

legacy_packages.name: bower
legacy_packages.reason: Bower's own site recommends Yarn and Vite instead; the last release is 1.8.14 (2022-03-14).
legacy_packages.replacement: npm (or pnpm/Yarn) with a bundler such as Vite

legacy_packages.name: node-sass
legacy_packages.reason: End of life: no more releases (last 9.0.0) and the repository is archived.

legacy_packages.name: laravel-mix
legacy_packages.reason: Webpack wrapper with no release since 2022-06-09 and no commit since 2024-01.

legacy_packages.name: vue
legacy_packages.reason: Vue 2 reached end of life on 2023-12-31 and no longer receives fixes.

legacy_packages.name: vue-template-compiler
legacy_packages.reason: Compiles Vue 2 templates only; Vue 2 is end of life.

legacy_packages.name: webpack
legacy_packages.reason: webpack 4 stopped at 4.47.0 (2023-09); the current line is 5.

legacy_packages.name: request
legacy_packages.reason: Deprecated on npm: the maintainers stopped development.

legacy_packages.name: phantomjs-prebuilt
legacy_packages.reason: Deprecated on npm; PhantomJS development is suspended.

native_cli_names._comment: Tools whose official channel is NOT the npm package of that bare name (winget/brew/apt/cargo/GitHub releases). `npx <name>` runs whatever owns that npm name - possibly a squatter. pm-audit flags npx.native-cli on these.
